# Battleship

> A Battleship game for Android that works offline, with no account. Built with Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + Material3. The app is in English and Danish.

## Overview

Battleship is an Android version of the classic naval combat game. One player plays against the computer on a 10×10 grid. Ships are placed by hand or automatically. The computer searches alternating squares of the grid and fires at the squares around a hit.

## Technology Stack

- Kotlin 2.3.21
- Jetpack Compose (BOM 2026.06.01) + Material3
- Navigation Compose 2.9.8
- ViewModel + StateFlow (MVVM)
- Clean Architecture (domain / presentation)
- No internet permission and no accounts. Career stats and medals are kept on the device in app-private storage, and Android may include them in your own backup.

## Architecture

- `domain/` — Pure Kotlin models (Ship, Board, ShipType, CellState, GamePhase, SuperWeapon) and the computer opponent (BattleshipAI)
- `presentation/` — Compose screens (Menu, About, Placement, Game, GameOver, Stats, Medals, Badges), ViewModel, Navigation

## Key Files

- `CLAUDE.md` — Project conventions, architecture, engineering principles
- `app/src/main/java/com/cocode/battleship/domain/ai/BattleshipAI.kt` — Stateless computer opponent (hunt and target)
- `app/src/main/java/com/cocode/battleship/presentation/game/GameViewModel.kt` — Single shared ViewModel for all screens
- `app/src/main/java/com/cocode/battleship/presentation/navigation/BattleshipNavHost.kt` — Navigation with shared ViewModel
